categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Sys Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in water environment governance, offering water treatment products, comprehensive water environment governance solutions, and project operation services. The company focuses on sewage treatment plant upgrades, river and lake basin governance, industrial wastewater treatment, sludge harmless treatment, rural sewage, environmental steward services, and black and odorous pond system governance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including rapid biological treatment technology and spore transfer technology, which are applied in their water treatment products such as rapid biological treatment systems and spore transfer systems. These technologies combine biological and physical-chemical methods to efficiently remove pollutants like nitrogen and phosphorus. The company also develops intelligent ion balance devices for industrial circulating water and deep water oxygenation devices for lake and reservoir water quality stabilization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government departments, state-owned enterprises, private enterprises, and municipal investment platforms. The company serves municipal sewage treatment plants, industrial parks, rural areas, and data centers, with a focus on domestic Chinese markets and expanding international markets in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with key markets in regions such as Yunnan, Hebei, Anhui, Shandong, Northeast China, and Gansu. It also actively expands its international presence in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Sys Science & Technology Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the water environment governance supply chain, providing integrated solutions from consulting, design, manufacturing of water treatment products, project implementation to operation and maintenance services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in water treatment technologies, focusing on enhancing nitrogen and phosphorus removal efficiency, energy-saving and low-carbon technologies, and smart water management platforms. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to develop advanced biological treatment materials, optimize existing technologies, and expand into emerging fields such as industrial wastewater treatment and sludge resource utilization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of water treatment products, comprehensive water environment governance project contracts, and ongoing project operation and maintenance services. The company uses a direct sales model and offers integrated lifecycle services to clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading innovative integrated service provider in the water environment governance sector in China, with recognized core technologies and a strong domestic market presence. It competes with other specialized water treatment and environmental technology firms, leveraging its patented technologies and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 191.3 million RMB, a decrease of 36.61% from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 131 million RMB, mainly due to increased credit impairment losses and slower project payment cycles. The company has a registered capital of about 68.57 million RMB and employs around 368 staff. Despite recent financial challenges, it continues to invest in R&D and expand its market footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies that achieve high-efficiency pollutant removal, energy-saving and low-carbon operation, and smart water management. Its integrated full lifecycle service model from consulting to operation ensures tailored solutions that meet diverse client needs. The company’s focus on innovation, quality, and comprehensive environmental stewardship services provides competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets.
